_about: A kit sheet for the formula estimate (math-fallback P2, `app/formula/genshin/sheets.py`). Structure (which number buffs what, for whom, under which condition) is transcribed from Genshin Optimizer's character sheets at `go_commit` (MIT), cited per effect to `pando:`/`wr:` file:lines under the `go` roots, and to gcsim's Go at `gcsim_commit` where gcsim implements the same buff. No number is written here: every value is a reference into the seeded catalogue (a talent row by label, a constellation or passive param_list by index), pinned under `pins` so a re-seed that changes one withholds the effect rather than misreading it.

conditions.label: Paramita Papilio has just ended (A1, to her teammates)
Hu Tao's HP is at or below 50% (A4)
An opponent marked by her Blood Blossom was just defeated nearby (C4, to her teammates)
Her HP fell below 25% and C6 triggered

effects.label: A1 Flutter By: CRIT Rate to her teammates after Paramita Papilio
A4 Sanguine Rouge: Pyro DMG at or below 50% HP
C2 Ominous Rainfall: Blood Blossom DMG + a share of her Max HP
C4 Garden of Eternal Rest: CRIT Rate to her teammates

unmodelled.what: Guide to Afterlife: ATK from her Max HP, capped at a multiple of her base ATK
unmodelled.reason: a capped conversion of her own Max HP (GO `min(prod(atkInc, premod.hp), prod(maxAtkInc, base.atk))`, pando:HuTao.ts:103-112): the recipe carries no cap on a per-candidate term, which is the owner's open question on capped self-conversions (DECISIONS §39); the cap is also a parameter no seeded row label names
an infusion changes a hit's element, which the estimate does not model (G4)
no damage effect: healing (its low-HP damage is its own row)

unmodelled.reason: no damage effect: RES and survival
